# Round-1 lock arithmetic (P2-R4 A, C-2, D-2)

**payload arithmetic, frozen E-branch boxes and channel constants only; no F output read, no network run.**

## A-1 Block

Transmitted grid 25 × 88, channels per branch [16, 64, 256]. Block = 5 × 8 cells = 16.0 m × 25.6 m; **55 blocks**; 640, 2,560, 10,240 elements per block on branches 0, 1, 2 = **13,440 elements per block**; 20 × 32 head cells per block (head grid 100 × 352). raster: index = row_block * (W / cols) + col_block, row-major, 0-based.

## A-2 Bitstream and overhead

Layout: [mask bitmap][block 0..K-1 in ascending block index; within a block branch 0, 1, 2; within a branch channel-major C x rows x cols]; then P1 packetisation (8,000-bit payload + 320-bit header per packet), LDPC K=500 n=1000, 16-QAM.

| item | bits per frame |
|---|---:|
| mask bitmap | 55 |
| index list | 0 |
| quantisation parameters | 0 |
| packet headers | 320 per packet, charged by the P1 chain |
| ldpc padding | charged by the P1 chain |
| request | not charged (identical for every action) |

Bits per block: 107,520. Mask loss: not modelled -- the layout is assumed known at the receiver, as P1 assumes for packet-header contents; the mask bits are still charged as payload.

## A-3 Budget and K_F

Link row: IEEE 802.11bd 20 MHz, zero-overhead upper bound, D_comm = 100 ms → **B_available = 1.3500 Msym**. Upper bound because: whole channel to one link, every data resource element, continuously; preamble, midambles, MAC, contention, queueing and the request are excluded, so a real link carries less and K_F is an upper bound on blocks sent.

**K_F = 23** of 55 blocks (41.8 %): 2,473,015 bits → 5,256 codewords → **N_sym,F(K_F) = 1.3140 Msym** ≤ B_available. 5,255 elements straddle two codewords in this message. The draft's reference value 23 is kept as reference only.

## A-4 L bound

Observed validate maximum: 51 collaborator boxes → N_sym,L = 0.00525 Msym; fits B_available: **yes** → **L is not truncated.** K_max under B_available would be 13,810 boxes; p99 of the box count is 49; expected truncation share 0.0 %. Rule: no truncation if the observed maximum fits; otherwise the collaborator sends the top min(N_box, K_max) boxes by confidence, and every policy using L follows the same rule.
